# Token Maker

> Token Maker is a browser-based VTT token maker for DnD, Roll20, Foundry VTT, and similar tabletop workflows. It helps users upload character art, crop portraits, apply token masks and borders, add labels, and export transparent PNG tokens.

Token Maker is designed for tabletop creators, game masters, players, and content publishers who need practical virtual tabletop tokens. The normal editor workflow is local-first: portrait images can stay in the browser during crop, style, and export.

The site has English pages at root-level URLs and Simplified Chinese pages under `/zh`. Use `sitemap.xml` for the full indexable URL set and `robots.txt` for crawler access rules. Do not treat this file as permission to access disallowed paths such as `/api/`.

## Core Pages

- [Token Maker home](https://www.tokenmaker.one/): Main browser editor and English overview for creating VTT tokens.
- [Token Maker Chinese home](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh): Simplified Chinese version of the main editor and overview.
- [DnD dice roller](https://www.tokenmaker.one/dice-roller-dnd): Browser dice roller for DnD stat rolls, common dice presets, roll logs, and tabletop use.
- [DnD dice roller Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/dice-roller-dnd): Simplified Chinese version of the DnD dice roller.
- [Armor creator](https://www.tokenmaker.one/armor-creator): Assemble armor in the browser and download an image.
- [Armor creator Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/armor-creator): 在浏览器里搭配护甲并下载图片。
- [Square token maker](https://www.tokenmaker.one/templates/square-token-maker): Square VTT token workflow for grid maps, 1:1 crops, borders, and transparent PNG export.
- [Square token maker Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/templates/square-token-maker): Simplified Chinese square token maker workflow.
- [FAQ](https://www.tokenmaker.one/faq): Questions about image handling, workflow fit, supported token styles, and export size.
- [FAQ Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/faq): Simplified Chinese FAQ.
- [Privacy](https://www.tokenmaker.one/privacy): Privacy information, including the local-first image workflow.
- [Contact](https://www.tokenmaker.one/contact): Public contact form for site feedback and support requests.

## Blog And Guides

- [Blog index](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog): English DnD, VTT token, and tabletop workflow articles.
- [Blog index Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog): Simplified Chinese article index.
- [D&D Halfling: The Source Label Comes Before the Character Card](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-halfling): Learn how the 2014/legacy race and 2024 Basic Rules species differ, then copy the matching traits and creation fields and preserve one readable character cue.
- [How to Get the Greenhouse in Stardew Valley](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/greenhouse-stardew): Get the Stardew Valley Greenhouse: finish all Pantry bundles, or buy Joja membership for 5,000g, return next in-game day for the form, buy the 35,000g project, sleep, and check the farm.
- [Matching CR 1/8 Does Not Make One DnD Kobold](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-kobold): A dnd kobold is the 2014 Kobold (Small Humanoid, Lawful Evil) or the 2024 Kobold Warrior (Small Dragon, Neutral). Same CR 1/8 does not make those one creature.
- [DnD Skills: Eighteen Names, Constitution Has No Skill](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-skills): Copy tonight's eighteen dnd skills from 2014 or 2024. Constitution has no skill; add d20 + the ability modifier + proficiency bonus if proficient.
- [DnD Conditions: Same Fifteen Names, Lock 2014 or 2024](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-conditions): Copy tonight's fifteen dnd conditions from 2014 or 2024. Grappled is not Restrained; Stunned is not Paralyzed; Exhaustion 2 then +1 is 3.
- [DnD Beholder: 2014 Cone Is a Trait, 2024 a Bonus Action](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-beholder): A dnd beholder is a CR 13 Large aberration copied from one Monster Manual year. Write 2014 or 2024 before the cone. Ten stalks stay in the token; four stalks is the spectator page.
- [Mind Flayer DnD: CR 7 Matches, The Stun Clock Doesn't](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/mind-flayer-dnd): A mind flayer dnd encounter is a CR 7 Medium aberration copied from one Monster Manual year. Write 2014 or 2024 on the tracker before the cone. Crop tentacles and the long skull inside the token.
- [DnD Cleric Spells: The 2024 Official Four Has No Healing Word](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-cleric-spells): The 2024 Free Rules four dnd cleric spells are Bless, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, and Shield of Faith. They leave no Bonus Action pickup. Swap Shield of Faith for Healing Word unless another character already has that rescue.
- [DnD Kenku: Speech Depends on Volo's or MotM](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-kenku): A dnd kenku is a wingless raven-person copied from Volo's or MotM, not from the 2024 Player's Handbook. Ask the DM which page is legal, copy that speech and Mimicry check, and keep the beak inside the token.
- [DnD Dragonborn: Lock 2014 or 2024, Then Copy Traits](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-dragonborn): Lock 2014 or 2024 for a dnd dragonborn, copy that book's traits and one ancestry color, take a clan-first name from the 2014 lists, and crop a token that still shows scales and horns.
- [DnD Druid: Build a Level 1 Caster, Then Unlock Wild Shape at Level 2](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-druid): A DnD Druid is a Wisdom caster who borrows tools from the land: control, emergency healing, and later a Beast form. The fantasy is usually the bear. Session one is not about the bear.
- [DnD Backgrounds: Which Origin Fits the Year You Play?](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-backgrounds): A Dungeons & Dragons background is the occupation and place that shaped the character before the first adventure.
- [DND Classes Compared: All 13 by Party Job and First Combat Turn](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-classes-comparison): There are 12 classes in the 2024 Player's Handbook, or 13 with official Artificer. Compare them by party job and the first combat turn at level 1.
- [Fill a DnD Character Sheet in Creation Order, Not Top Down](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-character-sheet): Fill a 2024 character sheet in creation order: class, origin, scores, then AC, HP, attacks, and spells, with one finished level 1 Cleric as the example.
- [DnD Fighter Guide: Build a Level 1 Fighter and Plan Every Turn](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-fighter): Build a level 1 Fighter with the right ability, armor, weapon, Fighting Style, Weapon Mastery, and a clear first combat turn.
- [D&D Player's Handbook: Choose 5e (2014) or 5.5e (2024)](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/players-handbook-dnd-5e): Choose the handbook that matches the campaign, keep the two rulesets separate, use official free rules, and prepare only what session one needs.
- [DnD Paladin Turn Plan: When to Heal, Smite, or Protect](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-paladin): Use a simple combat decision tree for attacks, Lay on Hands, Divine Smite, concentration, and positioning without wasting your action economy.
- [Which DND Artificer Fits Your Party Job?](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-artificer): Choose an Artificer from the job your party needs: support, front line, ranged firepower, companion play, maps, or horror science.
- [All Six DnD Stats Explained for Your First Character](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-stats): Understand all six ability scores, calculate modifiers, compare the three 2024 generation methods, and assign a level 1 array without mixing rulesets.
- [D&D Languages](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-languages): Choose two standard languages for a 2024 character, keep 2014 rules separate, and turn a language choice into a real campaign hook.
- [DnD Meaning](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-meaning): Distinguish Do Not Disturb from Dungeons & Dragons, then learn how a DM, player characters, dice, sessions, and optional VTT tokens fit together.
- [DnD Alignment Chart](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-alignment-chart): Read all nine alignments, judge order and morality separately, pressure-test one hard choice, and turn the result into repeatable roleplay.

- [DND Mage Armor Guide: AC Rules, Best Uses, and Common Rulings](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-mage-armor): Learn how dnd mage armor works, how to calculate AC, what it stacks with, who should use it, and the overlooked touch-target trick many players miss.
- [DND Giants: Split Type, Huge Space, and Encounter Controls](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-giants): Split Giant type from the six true DND giants, check 2014 and current Basic Rules, treat the Ordning as status, then lock map, morale, and tokens.
- [DND Dhampir Guide: Traits, Vampiric Bite, Best Classes, and Roleplay Tips](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-dhampir): Learn what a DND dhampir is, how Vampiric Bite works, which classes fit best, and how to roleplay the lineage without annoying your table.
- [DND Grung Guide: Traits, Best Classes, Poison Rules, and DM Tips](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-grung): Learn what a DND grung is, how poison and water dependency work, which classes fit best, and what to ask your DM before playing one.

- [D&D Constitution Guide](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-constitution-guide): Learn how D&D Constitution affects hit points, saving throws, concentration checks, and survivability. Includes score tables, class tips, FAQ, and a dice roller link.

- [DND Ranger Guide for 2014 and 2024 Rules](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-ranger): Build a DND Ranger with a clear 2014 or 2024 path, level 1–5 decisions, party-role checks, source-labeled subclasses, and an optional VTT token workflow.
- [DnD Wizard Spells: Prepare From the Spellbook, Not the Catalog](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-wizard-spells): dnd wizard spells on a legal sheet are prepared names from your spellbook, not a mixed catalog. Write 2014 or 2024 first, count spellbook / prepared / slots, skip rituals when the year allows, and keep one concentration job. 2014 uses Intelligence plus Wizard level; 2024 uses the Prepared Spells column (four at level 1, six at level 3).
- [D&D Schools of Magic Explained: The Eight Spell Schools and How to Read Them](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-schools-of-magic): dnd schools of magic names eight 2024 spell categories, not class features. Pair each school with a checked example, then check the spell, class list, and rules year.
- [DnD Warlock Spells: Six Choices, Two Slots, One Missing Party Job](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-warlock-spells): For a level-5 Warlock, use the 2024 rules to separate six base prepared-spell entries from two level-3 Pact Magic slots, then match each choice to your party's missing job.

## Optional

- [DND 半身人：25 英尺还是 30 英尺？先锁 2014/2024 规则再填卡](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-halfling): 按 DM 允许的来源分开填写 2014 种族或 2024 物种的体型、速度、属性值来源与特性，再核对身份标签和角色棋子在地图缩放下的可读性；年份或旧书许可未确认时，先问 DM。
- [星露谷物语温室怎么解锁：社区中心与 Joja 路线](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/greenhouse-stardew): 说明星露谷物语温室的两条解锁路线，分别讲清茶水间普通收集包、Joja 会员与温室项目的条件，以及完成后如何检查温室是否已经可用。
- [DND 狗头人（Kobold）不能同时抄瓦罗和魔邓肯](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-kobold): DND 狗头人（Kobold）是带鳞、小角的小龙类人。玩家卡只抄瓦罗或魔邓肯其中一页；同卡出现摇尾乞怜和龙吼就算失败。
- [dnd 5e 技能：体操对回特技，生存对回求生，观察对回察觉](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-skills): 今晚这张 dnd 5e 技能是绑在属性上的 18 项，不是法术表。体质没有技能，表里没有体质行。体操对回特技，生存对回求生，观察或技能名「感知」对回察觉。没熟练仍做该技能相关检定，只是不加熟练加值。专精是已经熟练的那一行加倍，0 的两倍还是 0。2014 和 2024 这 18 个英文名没有增删。
- [dnd 5e 状态：力竭已经 2 级再 +1，升到 3 不是只执行新得到的那 1 级](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-conditions): 今晚这张 dnd 5e 状态，中文叫状态，英文括注 Conditions。卡边写 2014《玩家手册》状态或 2024 术语表状态。附录仍是 15 个名字。受擒两边速度 0，敏捷豁免劣势只在束缚。震慑两版都没有 5 尺重击。力竭已经 2 级再获得 1 级升到 3，不是只执行新得到的那 1 级：2014 同时承受 1+2+3，2024 是 D20 检定 −6、速度 −15 尺。
- [眼魔：挑战等级 13 锁不住年，看反魔锥是特质还是附赠动作](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-beholder): 眼魔先锁 2014 或 2024《怪物图鉴》。两版都是挑战等级 13；分得开的是反魔锥是特质还是附赠动作。Token 要认出十根眼柄，四根是观察者眼魔。
- [夺心魔：别把 1 分钟震慑拼上不要求失能的采脑](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/mind-flayer-dnd): 夺心魔先锁 2014 或 2024《怪物图鉴》。两版都是挑战等级 7；分得开的是震慑能挂多久、采脑要什么条件。Token 要认出面触须，不要裁成电视剧或克苏鲁。
- [dnd 牧师法术（Cleric）：2024 灵体武器要专注，不能叠祝福术](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-cleric-spells): 2024 灵体武器改为专注，不能和祝福术或灵体卫士一起维持。dnd 牧师法术名单上可以同时写这三个名字；同一场战斗只能开一个主工作。2014 灵体武器仍不占专注。
- [dnd kenku（天狗）：瓦罗只能拟声，灰机缺页不等于魔邓肯不能开口](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-kenku): 瓦罗天狗 Kenku 语言栏按拟声写；魔邓肯开口不要用灰机缺页去填。拟声默认旁白，卡面留拟声名、桌上用短称呼，Token 要认出无翼有喙。
- [dnd dragonborn（龙裔）：先问 DM 抄 2014 还是 2024](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-dragonborn): 已经决定玩龙裔时，先问 DM 抄 2014 还是 2024，再按那一页写吐息和加值，把鳞色、伤害、抗性锁成一套，氏族名在前、桌上用短称呼。
- [DND 德鲁伊指南：先定职责，再准备法术与荒野变形](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-druid): 先确认 2014 或 2024 规则，再按队伍职责安排感知、体质、训练路线、准备法术和荒野变形。本文给出 1 级建卡顺序、版本差异表与不会卡住的回合计划。
- [DND 5E 背景怎么选：先定规则版本，再把过去写进冒险](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-backgrounds): 先分清 2014 与 2024 背景规则，再用技能缺口、起源专长和故事钩子筛选，让角色的过去不只写在卡上，也会在战役里继续发生作用。
- [DND职业有哪些：用队伍职责和第1回合对照全部13个官方职业](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-classes-comparison): 先回答 DND职业有哪些：2024《玩家手册》12 个，加上奇械师共 13 个官方职业。按队伍职责和第 1 回合对照后写下职业名。
- [DND 角色卡：按创角顺序填写，不要从上往下填](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog/dnd-character-sheet): 按 2024 创角顺序填角色卡：先职业、出身和属性，再算护甲等级、生命值、攻击和法术，并用一名 1 级人类侍僧牧师走完第一页。
